summary: Verified the GRN Approval button removal/rename + Warehouse dropdown removal + skip_movement backend change. UI: confirmed 'Create SAP Notification' button (grn-approve-button) is completely gone (count=0); the remaining action button (grn-approve-full-auto-button) is present and correctly labeled 'Post GRN in SAP'; the Warehouse select (grn-warehouse-select) is not rendered anywhere on the page (count=0); Site select still renders; Reject and Mark Discrepancy buttons still render. Approval form now shows only 3 fields (Supplier Invoice Number, Bill Date, Site). Backend: verified via a direct authenticated curl to POST /api/admin/grn/{doc_code}/approve-full-auto with site_id='P2' (non-P8) that the endpoint no longer returns HTTP 400 'Test Full Automated GRN is only set up for site(s) P8' - it now returns 404 'No shipment found for this code' (i.e. it passed the site check and reached the shipment lookup). Code review of server.py (endpoint at line 8552) and _start_full_auto_grn_job (line 8857) confirms FULL_AUTO_GRN_SITE_ALLOWLIST is entirely removed and finalize_goods_receipt is now called with skip_movement=True; supplier_shipment_service.finalize_goods_receipt (line 1212) correctly sets sap_movement_status='not_applicable' + sap_movement_result={'ok': True, 'reason': 'Warehouse movement skipped by design - GRN-only mode'} when skip_movement=True and skips _post_goods_movement_for_items entirely.
critical_code_review_comments: GrnApprovalPage.jsx line 888-892: the 'Manual GRN mode' Switch is hardcoded to checked=true & disabled=true. Per the code comment this is intentional ('Manual GRN is now the ONLY path for Supplier GRN; toggle kept visible but disabled'). However, note that this means the 'Post GRN in SAP' automated-Playwright branch is now dead-code-in-the-open on the GRN page: the toggle can never be turned off by any user, so the code paths gated on !manualMode may never actually execute in production. If Playwright GR is truly deprecated the toggle + non-manual UI paths should eventually be removed to avoid dead-code confusion. NOT a blocker for this task since the action buttons themselves are not gated on manualMode.

GrnApprovalPage.jsx line 1155: the confirm dialog summary shows the raw 'siteId' state. If the user hasn't selected a site (or the seeded shipment has site_id=null and account is bound to more than one site), the dialog will render an empty Site row. Consider defaulting siteId to the user's first bound site or showing '—' when empty.
